{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm only two channels exist
print(f'Unique channels: {df['channel'].unique()}')

# Filter for completed orders (only those count for revenue)
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
completed_df['revenue_numeric'] = completed_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm no QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_check = (completed_df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f'QA orders in completed set: {qa_check}')

# Calculate total revenue per channel
channel_revenue = completed_df.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue_numeric'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue per channel:
{channel_revenue}')

# Identify the channel with highest revenue
best_channel = channel_revenue.loc[channel_revenue['revenue_numeric'].idxmax(), 'channel']
highest_revenue = channel_revenue['revenue_numeric'].max()

print(f'Best channel: {best_channel}, Revenue: {highest_revenue}')"}
